crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows deepen
crypto_headlines.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $306.42M in net outflows on Nov 18 and spot Ether ETFs $39.83M, the second straight day of Bitcoin ETF outflows. BlackRock's IBIT led with $149M.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin slips under $63,000
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC fell below $63,000 on Nov 18 as selling pressure continued.

crypto_headlines.title: Court documents detail the $6.3B Binance hack
crypto_headlines.summary: The hack involved 192 crypto assets across 11 blockchains, including at least $3.46B in stablecoins.

crypto_headlines.title: $518M in illicit funds routed through Sky's PSM
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Inca Digital, North Korean hackers and other illicit actors converted freezable USDC into DAI and USDS through Sky's Peg Stability Module, with $101.9M linked directly to wallets including those behind the Bybit hack.

crypto_headlines.title: Russia weighs letting funds hold crypto
crypto_headlines.summary: Russia is considering letting investment funds buy and hold crypto and letting retail investors trade crypto futures.

crypto_headlines.title: Solana's 2027 roadmap
crypto_headlines.summary: The roadmap targets doubling network compute capacity and cutting token-account compute costs by 80%.

doginal_news.title: DDL TCG Championship registration is open
doginal_news.summary: Victorious Gary promo card holders can register for the first official DDL TCG Championship. Registration is open for 48 hours from Nov 18.

doginal_news.title: Pyth joins the WEF New Champions community
doginal_news.summary: Pyth Network has joined the World Economic Forum's New Champions community, with Davos next.

doginal_news.title: Pyth covers Anthropic from day one of trading
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's 24/7 index and 24/5 feed for Anthropic go live as trading starts, and the $ANT feed is live on Pyth today.

doginal_news.title: Pyth market data on LayerZero ATLAS
doginal_news.summary: ATLAS, a headless exchange on LayerZero's Zero chain, launches Nov 30, and Pyth market data will be available from day one.

doginal_news.title: Pyth at The Markets Summit in London
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's Mike Cahill speaks at 4 PM GMT today on a panel about APIs, algos and AI in electronic rates trading.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs (only reposts) and no DDSalesBot sales in the last 24 hours.
